GENERAL-MECHANISM CONTRIBUTIONS (proposal text only, no brain edit; each carries per-event instances, counterexamples, scope and a falsifier).

(1) INDEX-ROLL WINDOW BLOCK LEAN - n=2 spanning G21 and G23. The GSCI/BCOM NG roll window (flow_calendar in_gsci_roll, roughly bd5-bd9) carries the block's negative drift, and the block's non-roll remainder leans the OTHER way. Per event, never pooled as the conclusion: G21 in-roll days 0608 -890, 0609 +70, 0610 +490, 0611 -1,080 = -1,410 over 4 days; G21 out-of-roll 0612 +620, 0615 +160, 0616 +970, 0617 -970, 0618 +520, 0619 -110 = +1,190 over 6 days. G23 in-roll 0708 -520, 0709 -2,050, 0710 -660, 0713 -620, 0714 +200 = -3,650 over 5 days; G23 out-of-roll 0706 +100, 0707 +160, 0715 -60, 0716 -20, 0717 +180 = +360 over 5 days. G22 contains no roll window (bd15-bd2 span) and is correctly silent. SCOPE, stated tightly: this is a WINDOW-SUM / block-lean statement, NOT a per-day sign rule - the counterexamples are real and named (G21 0609 +70 and 0610 +490, G23 0714 +200), so a roll day is not sign-certain. USE: when a block's roll window is known at the open, the block LEAN should carry a negative prior, and a bullish fundamental limb inside the window needs more than its normal evidence to set a positive block lean. MECHANISM CAUTION, stated because it is load-bearing: a roll is a calendar-spread trade and has no business moving the outright by 38.5 cents; the defensible reading is that the window supplies sustained front-leg offers that let a bearish catalyst run without a defended bid, not that the roll generates the move. FALSIFIER: a staged block whose roll window sums POSITIVE while its non-roll remainder sums negative. REQUIRED MEASUREMENT before promotion beyond a lean: stage the next-month leg (NGU26 here) so roll flow can be separated from outright liquidation - see declared_defects.

(2) STEO-KNOWABLE-DAY REVISION SIGN, AND THE BURN-INSTRUMENT RANK - n=2 spanning G21 and G23. On the first session a new STEO vintage is knowable (state steo_vintage.knowable_from == the session date), the SIGN of the total_consumption / power_burn revision versus the prior vintage matched the day's direction in both staged instances. G21 20260610: consumption +0.5254, power burn +0.3930 (production also +0.5662, i.e. the demand limbs bullish against a bearish supply limb) -> day +490. G23 20260708: consumption -1.1962, power burn -0.9260, production +0.2370 (both demand limbs bearish, supply limb bearish) -> day -520. THE RANKING CLAUSE is the part that matters and is what my day tests: on 0708 the EIA-930 realized-burn read pointed the OTHER way (est_gas_burn 44.9 Bcf/d, at the G22 block max, gas +610 GWh w/w) and LOST. Proposed rule: when two burn instruments contradict on the same session, the FORWARD monthly balance revision outranks the D+2-stale realized-grid observation for a forward price. SCOPE: STEO-release-knowable sessions only, both instances Wednesdays, n=2 - thin, and I say so; the sign of a single monthly revision is not proposed as a standing daily instrument. FALSIFIER: a STEO-knowable session whose consumption-revision sign is contradicted by the day move while grid_stack agrees with the day move.

(3) BURN_CONVERSION_GATE - SCOPE NARROWING OFF ITS OWN G23 FORWARD TEST. The play's up-limb call ('burn-confirmed slope lean = full band') fired cleanly 3 times in G23 (0708, 0715, 0716) and delivered 0 of 3, with one sign error worth 770 USD against the assembled blind; its damper limb (wind-on/burn-down -> suppress) pointed correctly on 0709 and 0710. Proposed rewrite: burn confirmation becomes PERMISSION TO HOLD a band that other evidence sets, never a directional lean of its own; the damper limb is unchanged; the play gains an explicit precedence clause deferring to a contradicting forward balance revision (item 2). Falsifier for the rewrite: a G24+ block in which burn-confirmed CDD-add days carry that block's up-lean. This is a genuine refutation of a mechanism merged hours before the blind ran, delivered on the forward test the play itself named, and it should be recorded as a refutation and not softened.

(4) FLAGGED OBSERVATION, EXPLICITLY NOT PROPOSED AS A RULE - the price-free absorption tell. The 0707 configuration that would have flipped my day (session_signed_flow strongly positive while phase_b_share DECLINES and sits below 0.50 across every phase = size-concentrated buying against a broad sell base) is exactly right on my instance and is the answer to my own adjudication. But I tested it across all 30 staged sessions of G21/G22/G23 and the loose form does NOT generalize: D-1 signed flow >= +1,000 with a near-balanced two-sided share produced 2 hits (0708 -520, 0710 -660), 3 flats (0609 +70, 0715 -60, 0716 -20) and 2 CLEAN COUNTEREXAMPLES (0618 +520, 0626 +230). The strict conjunction (phase flow monotonically RISING while phase b_share monotonically FALLING, all three phases) isolates 0708 alone - n=1 - with 0717 as a consistent mirror (rising share + rising flow -> +180). n=1 with a named mirror is not a rule and I will not propose it as one. WHAT I DO PROPOSE is the measurement: a sweep of this conjunction across the full staged corpus, because if it holds it is a PRICE-FREE absorption detector the blind can carry, and flow.price_free_absorption_proxy - the instrument that currently occupies that slot - MIS-READ this instance (0.535, nearer its 0.585 absorber-gone centroid than its 0.436 absorber-present centroid, against a truth of absorber PRESENT) and was saved only by failing its own 0.547 confirm bar. A proxy that leans wrong and is rescued by its bar is a proxy whose centroids need re-measuring, not one that passed.

(5) HANDOFF CONTENT RULE (contributes to the S104 Friday sign-off doctrine, extending it past Fridays). My blind's forward note to the print-day owner asserted a chain state CONDITIONAL on its own forecast being right ('D-1 (my day expected) coherent-buy ... if my day delivers coherent buy'), and the condition failed while the conclusion was still read forward. Proposed: a handoff must state the INHERITED STATE and the OBSERVABLE that would invalidate it, and must never forward a chain-polarity conclusion contingent on the emitting day's own unverified forecast. The coordinator already enforces handoff EXISTENCE on weekend-feeding days; the same existence check should extend to any day feeding a CATALYST day (EIA print, opex, expiry), because a print day's magnitude is sized off the inherited chain state and G23's 0709 is the block's largest single error at 1,800 USD.
